ios.desc:
Infinite Flight offers the most comprehensive flight simulation experience on mobile devices, whether you are a curious novice or a decorated pilot. Explore high definition scenery around the entire world with our diverse inventory of detailed aircraft, and fly with others in our busy multiplayer environment with human Air Traffic Control! 

Take Control of Your Dream Aircraft

A fleet of detailed aircraft awaits, ranging from single-engine propeller to military fighters and airliners. Configure your flight with comprehensive planning tools, including weight and balance, and take off in your favorite aircraft and livery combination. Advanced autopilot functions including VNAV, LNAV, and autoland will have you flying like a pro. 

Explore the World

Fly anywhere on the globe with high-definition satellite terrain imagery at 15m/px resolution. Navigate with a global database of NAVAIDs, SIDs, STARs, Approaches, and Oceanic tracks, ensuring an authentic flight planning experience. Compatible airports even support auto-pushback in coordination with ATC instructions, making your pre-flight setup seamless.Enjoy realistic airport environments with 3D terminals, animated ground service equipment, jet bridges, and functional stand guidance at a growing number of airports worldwide.

Fly with others in controlled airspace

Flight simulation is best with others! Join a vibrant multiplayer community where pilots navigate busy airspace with human Air Traffic Controllers. Whether you're flying or controlling, beginner and expert server options provide a structured and realistic ATC experience. Coordinate with other pilots, follow real-world procedures, and take your skills to the next level in a truly immersive airspace.

INCLUDED FEATURES
• Curated selection of aircraft and locations		
• Growing selection of 3D Airports		
• ILS plus NAV Data including SIDS, STARS, GPS approaches		
• Realistic Atmospherics with customizable time of day & weather conditions, and cirrus clouds		
• Autopilot with LNAV, VNAV, Autoland (select aircraft)		
• Flight Planning, taxiway networks, auto-pushback		
• Logbook and advanced replay system		
• Weight & Balance config		
• Aircraft cockpit, door, jet bridge, and ground service animations
• Engine startup & shutdown		
• Stand guidance at equipped airports

SUBSCRIBE TO INFINITE FLIGHT PRO to enjoy our entire fleet of aircraft with thousands of other pilots, anywhere in the world.

INFINITE FLIGHT PRO FEATURES
• Multiplayer 
• Global flight

quotes.story_title: Show HN: Our flight sim for iOS: Infinite Flight

quotes.text:
We started this flight simulator about 2 years ago to be PC based, after realizing that it was too big of a task, we switched to Windows Phone 7 (Release Apr 2011) and recently released on iOS (March 2012).

So far, the reviews have been encouraging, and we're closing in on our second update. Last update brought iPad3 support, new airplanes and bug fixes. Next one will bring 2 additional aircrafts, missions, better map, IFR Fixes/Airways...

Now, for the things that the HN crowd might be interested in:

- It's entirely in C#. Codebase of the simulator itself (excluding XNA, MonoGame) is 99% shared between WP7 and iOS.

- The user base on iOS is much larger than on WP7, the numbers go far beyond our wildest expectations. (It's a bit early to tell, but something like 30x to 45x what we had on Windows Phone so far)

- The physics engine is custom, we're using rigid body simulation and apply forces based on angle of attack, airspeed, lift tables...

- Using MonoGame/MonoTouch has been incredible, the guys at Xamarin are great!

- We did run into issues with Garbage Collection, but nothing that we couldn't solve with a classic optimization session at the end

- People seem to love the fact that we setup a uservoice site. (http://feedback.flyingdevstudio.com). We've got tons of suggestions and we'll try to implement what people want first.
